text: Just as she was leaving the room,
She was inclined to make an acknowledgment, which she thought would please her father.
translation: 그녀는 아버지를 기쁘게 해드릴 것이라고 생각하여 인정하는 경향이 있었습니다.

text: But which, to be full and true, must include a little annoyance.
translation: 그러나 이것이 완전하고 사실이 되려면 약간의 성가심을 포함해야 합니다.

text: I'm sorry, but I can't help you.
I'm afraid I can't help you.
translation: 제가 당신을 도와드릴 수 없을 것 같습니다.
